To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
energy harvesting can be used to extend the lifetime of sensor nodes, and that energy harvesting can enable new sensor network applications.
Energy-harvested nodes can operate in a variety of ways to achieve the design goals of long lifetime, low cost, high reliability and high coverage.
energy-harvesting nodes can provide longer lifetime and better sensing coverage than battery-powered sensor nodes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to make the best use of the energy that is available at any given time, in any given location, in any given application.
the design of energy-harvesting sensor nodes and the implications of harvesting on sensor network operation and design.
the design and development of energy-harvesting sensor systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the energy harvesting is an emerging technology and has great potential to address the energy problem of wireless sensor networks.
the future of wireless sensor nodes is energy harvesting.
energy harvesting sensor nodes are a viable solution for many applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

energy harvesting is not a panacea for all sensor node design challenges, but it can be an enabling technology for a class of applications that require a long lifetime, and that the design of harvesting-based nodes must consider the characteristics of the harvesting source, the storage and management of harvested energy, and the trade-offs between performance and lifetime.
energy harvesting sensor nodes can address the conflicting design requirements of long lifetimes and good performance.
energy harvesting sensor networks are an emerging technology with great potential to enable novel applications and to improve performance and lifetime of existing applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of energy harvesting sensor nodes is a challenging problem, requiring the consideration of many factors.
the design of energy harvesting sensor nodes and networks is not simply a matter of adding a power source to the existing design.
harvesting-based solutions are feasible and can address the design challenges of sensor nodes.
